title: Does anyone else dream of being stuck in a GIANT store?
content: For me it was walmart but I was a lot younger in that dream probably 8 or 9. However the dream seemed like it was a total of 10 minutes but I ended up sleeping for 10 hours. All I remember was me being stuck in walmart then at the next second I was screaming for my mom after I got out but it was pitch black and then I woke up. This is probably one of my weirdest dreams.
